## Cause found

The logs record the transition directly: at 13:55 the flag `monthly-spend-feature` went from `off` to `on` (mid-minute split: `off 47 / on 153`), and in the same minute the error signature changed from a low-rate `UpstreamTimeout` background to a `ZeroDivisionError` in `spend_summary.py:32`, with error rate jumping 0.01 → 0.21 and holding at 0.27–0.35. No deploys or other changes are recorded in the week before the onset.

hypotheses.subject: monthly-spend-feature
hypotheses.summary: The feature flag `monthly-spend-feature` was turned on at 13:55, exposing an unguarded division in the monthly spend summary code path. Account page requests that hit the new path raised ZeroDivisionError at src/io_shop/spend_summary.py:32, driving the error rate from ~1% to 21-34%.

supporting_evidence.claim: ERROR io-shop: account page request failed - ZeroDivisionError: division by zero at src/io_shop/spend_summary.py:32
error_rate jumps from 0.01 at 13:54 to 0.21 at 13:55 and stays elevated (0.24, 0.345, 0.325, 0.32, 0.27, 0.335) with request_volume flat at 1200
Before the flip the only errors were a low background of 'UpstreamTimeout: payment authorization timed out' at 0-1% per minute

hypotheses.summary: Alternative: an unrecorded code change (deploy) shipped the faulty spend_summary.py division and the flag flip merely revealed it. The change channel shows no deploy in the 7 days before onset, so this cannot be confirmed; the operational trigger remains the flag going on.

supporting_evidence.claim: Every recorded change to io-shop from 2026-09-10T00:00:00Z to 2026-09-17T14:01:00Z. (nothing changed in this window)
